'''Listehol''' was an astronomical object<ref name="Visual Dictionary" /> located in the [[Listehol system]] in the [[Kwymar sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="Appendix" /> Located on the [[Hydian Way]],<ref name="Map" /> it was the head of the [[Listehol Run]]<ref name="Listehol" /> [[hyperspace route]] which linked it to [[Mirial]].<ref name="Map" /> It was the [[homeworld]] of the tyrant [[Baron]] [[Yasto Attsmun]], [[captain]] of the ''[[Undisputed Victor]]'' on [[Cantonica]].<ref name="Visual Dictionary" />
